county.note: Declared elected with 270,928 votes (Gazette Notice No. 9949 of 2022, as cited by Mzalendo). No impeachment or removal of the Governor found as of Nov 2026.

county.name: Elijah Obebo
county.since: Jul 2024 (sworn in after a High Court order)
county.note: Robert Monda, elected Deputy Governor with Governor Arati in 2022, was impeached by the County Assembly; the Senate upheld the impeachment in March 2024. The Governor nominated Elijah Obebo, then chair of the County Public Service Board, and the Assembly approved him. On 4 July 2024 the High Court at Kisii directed the IEBC to gazette him or have him sworn in; he was sworn in at Gusii Stadium in July 2024. Monda went to court against his removal; conservatory orders were refused in 2024 and no final outcome was found as of Nov 2026.

mcaGazetteNote: Built 27 Nov 2026. All 45 MCAs from IEBC Gazette Notice No. 9956 (Vol. CXXIV, No. 170, 24 Aug 2022), file sha256 eafe12d9…23e2a; every name, party and vote count was matched by script to its ward line in the PDF text. Names are written other names, then surname, as in the Nyamira file; for 11 wards (Kiamokama, Kiogoro and all of Kitutu Chache North and South) the gazette columns may hold the names in a different order, noted on each. The IEBC by-election gazette of 1 Dec 2025 lists no Kisii ward, and searches did not find any Kisii MCA death, nullification or by-election since Aug 2022 (not exhaustive). Party names are those printed in 2022; members may have changed party since. Keep mcaGazetteChecked false until the flagged names are checked against the County Assembly member list.
